evidence.excerpt: Bošković completed a two-year industry contract with a regional automotive polymer parts supplier focused on cooling channel redesign and warpage reduction, with regular on-site involvement at their production facility. He also participated in shorter consultations for two other Serbian plastics manufacturers on simulation-based process troubleshooting.
